name: War-Awoken Shadowbind Twinflash! (Weapon Skill)
effects: One single attack (11.00 or 66.00 each) capped at 199,999 based on ATK and MAG. Grants [Poison Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Poison 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to all allies if Level 2+ EnPoison, grants [Attach Poison 2 with Stacking] to user if not.
